subject: science
concept: Applying matter and materials knowledge to a real-world scenario using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student solves a realistic scenario requiring them to choose a state of matter or material property correctly
exercise.pictorial: Student illustrates their solution to the scenario
exercise.abstract: Student explains their reasoning for the chosen material/state-of-matter solution in a short written response

misconception_flags: gives a correct final answer but cannot explain the reasoning connecting it to matter/material properties

interest_binding: scenario generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
